messages:
Aisha: Our rubber fern by the big window needs a name. 60-second quip-off — winner gets a sticker. Drop your one-liners! :tada:
Marco: Fernie Sanders. got to promise it won't filibuster our meetings. :fire:
Priya: Chair-y Plant (because it sits near chairs?) ... okay that was terrible. :grimacing:
Jonas: The Green Undertaker — plants are dramatic here. :skull:
Mei: Leaf Erickson — adventurous and leafy. :sunglasses:
Olga: I vote "Photosynthesus Maximus" — sounds like a legend. :rofl:
Sam: "Airbnb" (Because it always hosts forgotten lunch containers). :stuck_out_tongue:
Priya: Also offering a bonus 2-word caption: "Silent Partner" :smile:
Marco: Quick poll: react with :one: for Fernie, :two: for Leaf Erickson, :three: for Photosynthesus, :four: other
DevBot: Trivia: office plant last watered 3 days ago — reminder sent to #eng-infra
Mei: "Fernie" gets my :one: but I'm partial to a punny plaque. :leafy_green:
Olga: Whoever wins has to make a tiny name tag. Stakes are high. :laughing:
Aisha: Deadline: 5pm today. I'll tally reactions and announce the winner before the standup. Go! :clock5:
Sam: Quick one-liner submission: "Our plant is silently judging your coffee choices." :coffee:
Jonas: "Photosynthesus Maximus" sealed with a dramatic wink. :wink:
Marco: adding :one: (Fernie) — and leaving this thread for the plant to respond in vibes. :seedling:
Aisha: Tallying now... thanks for the quips, everyone! :sparkles:
